findings.doc_quote: - 项目里放两份文件：`docs/decisions.md` 记用户亲口定的事，`docs/declined.md` 记他拒绝过的，让 Agent 先读，定过的不再问。
findings.problem: Docs refer to `docs/decisions.md`; the directory `docs/` exists but that file does not.
findings.name: docs/decisions.md
why: `docs/` is a top-level directory of the repository and `docs/` exists
the file is not tracked, not on disk and the sentence does not ask the reader to create it
findings.what_this_check_means: A file path written in inline code does not exist in the repository.
